---
title: "J20 optogenetic data"
output: html_notebook
---
Libraries
```{r}
library(lme4)       #mixed models
library(lmerTest)   #mixed models
library(ggplot2)    #plot graphs
library(ggpubr)     #edit graphs with theme() 
library(tidyverse)  #set of packages which include dplyr and tidyr
library(foreign)    #read in SPSS files
library(sjPlot)     #make forest plots and nice tables from lme
library(flextable)  #makes nice tables
library(svglite)    #expo grobs as SVG files
```
Set working directory and load in df
```{r}
#set working directory
setwd("~/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/Manuscripts/ATN to RSC J20/J20 data/R scripts")

#read in SPSS file to data frame
ATN_input<-read.spss("J20.sav", use.value.label=TRUE, to.data.frame=TRUE)

#filter out interneurons
ATN_pyr<-ATN_input%>%
  filter(Celltype == 'Pyramidal') 
```

```{r}
# Colour palette define
GenotypeColour <- c(
  "Tg" = "#EA2376",
  "WT" = "#6D47B4"
)

```

EPSC magnitude mixed model analysis
```{r}
#null model
EPSC.null<- lmer(Amplitude_7Hz ~ (1 + 1|Mouse), data=ATN_pyr, REML=FALSE)
summary(EPSC.null)

#model 1 area, layer
EPSC.mem.1 <- lmer(Amplitude_7Hz ~ Area + Layer + (1 + 1|Mouse), data=ATN_pyr, REML=FALSE)
  summary(EPSC.mem.1)

#model 2 area, layer, age, genotype
EPSC.mem.2<- lmer(Amplitude_7Hz ~ Area + Layer + Age + Genotype + (1 + 1|Mouse) , data=ATN_pyr, REML=FALSE)
  summary(EPSC.mem.2)

#model 3 area, layer, age, genotype, sex
  EPSC.mem.3<- lmer(Amplitude_7Hz ~ Area + Layer + Age + Genotype + Sex + (1 + 1|Mouse) , data=ATN_pyr, REML=FALSE) 
  summary(EPSC.mem.3)

  
#Anova to compare null and experimental models  
#if( require("xtable") ){
#  ft1 <- xtable_to_flextable(xtable(anova(EPSC.mem.1, EPSC.mem.2, EPSC.mem.3, EPSC.null), hline.after = c(1)))%>%
 #   set_header_labels("npar"="Parameter n", "logLik"="log Liklihood", "deviance"="Deviance", "Chisq"="X2", "Pr..Chisq."="p value")%>%
  #  add_header_lines(values="ANOVA model comparison")%>%
   # colformat_double(j=9, digits=3)
  #ft1   
#}
  
#get ANOVA table of Type III tests with Satterthwaite approximation for experimental model 1
#if( require("xtable") ){
 #  ft2 <- xtable_to_flextable(xtable(anova(EPSC.mem.1, type = "marginal", adjustSigma = F), hline.after = c(1)))%>%
#     set_header_labels("Sum.Sq"="Sum of Squares", "Mean.Sq"="Mean of Squares", "NumDF"="Numerator df", "DenDF"="Denominator df", "F.value"="F", #"Pr..F."="p value")%>%
#     add_header_lines(values="ANOVA Type III effects")%>%
#     colformat_double(j=7, digits=3)
#ft2   
#}

#get ANOVA table of Type III tests with Satterthwaite approximation for experimental model 3
#if( require("xtable") ){
#   ft2 <- xtable_to_flextable(xtable(anova(EPSC.mem.3, type = "marginal", adjustSigma = F), hline.after = c(1)))%>%
#     set_header_labels("Sum.Sq"="Sum of Squares", "Mean.Sq"="Mean of Squares", "NumDF"="Numerator df", "DenDF"="Denominator df", "F.value"="F", #"Pr..F."="p value")%>%
#     add_header_lines(values="ANOVA Type III effects")%>%
#     colformat_double(j=7, digits=3)
#ft2   
#}

#create predictor label list
predictor_labels_table<- list("Area: gRSC","Layer: Deep")
predictor_labels<- list("Layer: Deep", "Area: gRSC" )

#forest plot Amplitude_7Hz effect sizes
sjPlot:: plot_model(EPSC.mem.3, 
                   # axis.labels=c(predictor_labels),
                   show.values=TRUE,
                   show.p=TRUE, 
                   title="Effect of predictors on EPSC magnitude",
                   vline.color="black")+
                   theme_classic2()

#create formatted table of effect sizes
EPSC.table.1<-
sjPlot:: tab_model(EPSC.mem.1,
                   show.re.var=TRUE,
                   show.stat=TRUE,
                   collapse.ci=TRUE,
                   pred.labels=c("Intercept", predictor_labels_table),
                   dv.labels="EPSC magnitude")
EPSC.table.2<-
sjPlot:: tab_model(EPSC.mem.2,
                   show.re.var=TRUE,
                   show.stat=TRUE,
                   collapse.ci=TRUE,
                   pred.labels=c("Intercept", predictor_labels_table),
                   dv.labels="EPSC magnitude")
EPSC.table.3<-
  sjPlot:: tab_model(EPSC.mem.3,
                   show.re.var=TRUE,
                   show.stat=TRUE,
                   collapse.ci=TRUE,
                   pred.labels=c("Intercept", predictor_labels_table),
                   dv.labels="EPSC magnitude")

#combine mem tables
tab_model(EPSC.mem.1,EPSC.mem.2,EPSC.mem.3,
          pred.labels = c("Intercept", "Area: gRSC", "Layer: Deep","Age: 6 months", "Age: 9 months", "Genotype: Tg", "Sex: Female"),
          dv.labels = c("Model 1", "Model 2", "Model 3"),
          show.re.var=TRUE,
          show.stat=TRUE,
          collapse.ci=TRUE,
          string.stat = "t")

#plot Amplitude_7Hz data box plots
EPSC.plot<-        
ATN_pyr%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Age, y=Amplitude_7Hz, fill=Genotype))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA, alpha = 0.8)+  # alpha for transparency
   geom_point(colour="black", size = 0.5, position=position_jitterdodge())+
  scale_fill_manual(values=GenotypeColour)+
    facet_grid(Area ~ Layer, scales="free_x")+
    labs(y = "EPSC magnitude (pA)", x="Age (months)")+
    scale_x_discrete(labels=(c("3","6","9")))+
#    stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "errorbar", aes(ymax = ..y.., ymin = ..y.., group=Genotype), width = .7, linetype = "dashed", position=position_dodge())+ #add dashed line for mean
    theme_classic2()+
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size=12), axis.text.x = element_text(size=12), axis.text.y = element_text(size=12))+
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size=12), legend.text = element_text(size=12))+
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size=12))+
    theme(panel.border=element_rect(color = "gray45", fill = NA, size = 1))

#save as pdf file
ggsave(file="J20 EPSC boxplot.pdf", plot=EPSC.plot, height=6, width=10)
```

model 4 rise time
```{r}
#model 3 area, layer, age, genotype, sex
Rise.mem.4<- lmer(Rise_7Hz ~ Age + (1 + 1|Mouse) , data=ATN_pyr, REML=FALSE) 
  summary(Rise.mem.4)
  
#Anova to compare null and experimental models  
if( require("xtable") ){
  ft1 <- xtable_to_flextable(xtable(anova(Rise.mem.4, Rise.null), hline.after = c(1)))%>%
    set_header_labels("npar"="Parameter n", "logLik"="log Liklihood", "deviance"="Deviance", "Chisq"="X2", "Pr..Chisq."="p value")%>%
    add_header_lines(values="ANOVA model comparison")%>%
    colformat_double(j=9, digits=3)
  ft1   
}

#get ANOVA table of Type III tests with Satterthwaite approximation for experimental model
if( require("xtable") ){
   ft2 <- xtable_to_flextable(xtable(anova(Rise.mem.4, type = "marginal", adjustSigma = F), hline.after = c(1)))%>%
     set_header_labels("Sum.Sq"="Sum of Squares", "Mean.Sq"="Mean of Squares", "NumDF"="Numerator df", "DenDF"="Denominator df", "F.value"="F", "Pr..F."="p value")%>%
     add_header_lines(values="ANOVA Type III effects")%>%
     colformat_double(j=7, digits=3)
ft2   
}

Rise.table.4<-
  sjPlot:: tab_model(Rise.mem.3,
                   show.re.var=TRUE,
                   show.stat=TRUE,
                   collapse.ci=TRUE,
                   # pred.labels=c("Intercept", predictor_labels_table),
                   dv.labels="Rise magnitude")

tab_model(Rise.mem.1,Rise.mem.2,Rise.mem.3,Rise.mem.4,
          pred.labels = c("Intercept", "Area: gRSC", "Layer: Deep","Age: 6 months", "Age: 9 months", "Genotype: Tg", "Sex: Female"),
          dv.labels = c("Model 1", "Model 2", "Model 3","Model 4"),
          show.re.var=TRUE,
          show.stat=TRUE,
          collapse.ci=TRUE,
          string.stat = "t")
```

read in PPR transposed file
```{r}
#set working directory
#setwd("C:/Users/gm440/OneDrive - University of Exeter/U drive/Ephys data analysis/R")

#read in PPR_ISI restructered data SPSS file to data frame
PPR1<-read.spss("J20_PPR_ISI.sav", use.value.label=TRUE, to.data.frame=TRUE)

#filter out interneurons
PPR1_pyr<-PPR1%>%
  filter(Celltype == 'Pyramidal') 
#list repeated measure factors

PPR1_pyr$Index1<- factor(PPR1_pyr$Index1, 
                levels=c("PPR1", "PPR2", "PPR3", "PPR4", "PPR5", "PPR6", "PPR7"),
                labels=c("10 ms", "17 ms", "51ms", "100 ms", "170 ms", "510 ms", "1000 ms"))

PPR1_pyr<- 
  PPR1_pyr%>% rename(IPI = Index1, 
                    PPR = PPR_ISI)
```
PPR mixed model analysis
```{r}
#null model
PPR1.null<- lmer(PPR ~ as.factor(IPI) + (1 + 1|Mouse), data = PPR1_pyr) #set factors and predictors
summary(PPR1.null)

#Model 1 area, layer
PPR1.mem.1<- lmer(PPR ~ as.factor(IPI) + Area + Layer + (1|Mouse), data = PPR1_pyr)
  summary(PPR1.mem.1)
#Model 2 area, layer, age, genotype
PPR1.mem.2<- lmer(PPR ~ as.factor(IPI) + Area + Layer + Age + Genotype + (1|Mouse), data = PPR1_pyr)
  summary(PPR1.mem.2)
#Model 3 area, layer, age, genotype, sex
PPR1.mem.3<- lmer(PPR ~ as.factor(IPI) + Area + Layer + Age + Genotype + Sex + (1|Mouse), data = PPR1_pyr)
```
